messages:
Maya C: Kicking off sawtooth warmup for v3.2.0 — US canary in ~20m. EU pinned to v3.1.8 for now, APAC in warm pool only. Please monitor capacity and thermal.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: v3.2.0 -> canary(us). ETA 18m. Rollout id r-20260321-01

Raj P: Capacity check — current warm pool counts: us-west 12 GPUs, eu-west 6, apac-sg 4. Thermal headroom ~16%. Recommend throttle canary qps to 30% of normal.

Jordan (ops): +1 on lowering QPS. Add short-circuit rule: fallback to quantized variant if per-process memory > 9GB.

Ana L: Release notes ready? Callouts: kv-cache fix, continuous-batching perf improvements, small routing tweak. Draft link: https://go/release/3.2.0 (will post channel announcement).

Maya C: Quick plan: 0) push canary in US at 10% traffic for 1h 1) monitor latency, errors, OOMs 2) if error rate >0.5% or OOMs spike, rollback/pin EU 3) if thermal >85% pause rollout. Tagging @Jordan (ops) and @Luis G for handoff. :thumbsup:

Luis G: I'll watch infra metrics. If eviction_count > 5 in any 15m window, cut that slice to quantized and open rollback window.

Raj P: Rollback/pin snippet for quick use:
```bash
# pin EU to stable
./deployctl pin --region=eu --version=v3.1.8
# rollback canary entirely
./deployctl rollback --id=r-20260321-01
```

deploy-bot: Canary started: r-20260321-01 -> us (10%) at 4959999000

Ana L: Noted. Announcement draft uploaded, and changelog entry live.

Maya C: Smoke update (10%): p50 +2ms, p99 +8ms, error 0.1% — holding at 10%. Thermal stable. Proceeding to 25% in 30m unless alarms.

Jordan (ops): Oncall standing by. If p99 > 200ms or error >0.5% we rollback.

Luis G: Observing small OOM spikes on a specific slice; moving that slice to quant variant now. Pushing rule:
```yaml
route:
  if model_mem > 9GB: model = v3.2.0-q
```

Raj P: Also suggest boosting cache TTL for first 2 hours to reduce cold reloads.

Maya C: Updated rollout to 25% at 4959999380 — ramp staged.

deploy-bot: Rollout updated: r-20260321-01 -> us (25%) at 4959999380

Ana L: EU remains pinned until explicit go/no-go at 2h post-canary. APAC held in warm pool only.

Jordan (ops): All good from ops side, standing down unless alarms fire.

Maya C: Decision: schedule EU cutover tomorrow in change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will run EU canary then (same sawtooth plan). Closing this thread — will open EU cutover thread with exact timings and handoff. Thanks all. :wave:
